As_3CDo_.basis: Part 1 (Book 56) of a two-part work; As_3CDp_ (Book 57) is already ༼སྨད་ཆ།༽ and As_3CDp_ carries the colophon. Follows As_3CDk_ / As_3CDl_. Already uploaded: title patched on the library (PATCH /v2/texts/PTeAvbIVuWhNUWmDhTOvx, 2026-10-23).

At_3CG7.basis: Own colophon title (^a-1). At_3CG6's colophon calls itself the extensive (རྒྱས་པ) sādhana; this is the short one.

At_3CGI.basis: Full form from its own ^I-2 and colophon (^a-1). Note: At_3CGH ends with the same wording (^1-7) — the two remain near-identical to readers.

At_3CGb_.basis: Editorial: no distinct title is attested. The rite is pacifying in its own words (ཞི་བར་བྱ་བའི་ཕྱིར, ཞི་བའི་ཚིག, ཤནྟི་ཀུ་རུ ×2); At_3CG8 has none of these.

At_3CHB.basis: Editorial author qualifier. Different works with the same Tibetan title: Atiśa's Caryāsaṃgrahapradīpa vs Āryadeva's Caryāmelāpakapradīpa (Sanskrit titles in ^I-1). ཇོ་བོ་རྗེ from the collection title.

Ha_3CFJ.basis: Volume 5 (Book 86) of a five-volume set; follows the ༼དེབ་N།༽ pattern of Ha_3CFF / Ha_3CFH / Ha_3CFI.

Ha_3CFG.basis: Volume 2 (Book 83) was missing its volume tag. Already uploaded: deleted (old text tce5facfRtmmMP067sELa) and re-uploaded under the new title.

Na_3C9T.basis: Editorial, from its own homage (^I-2). Dropped 3 alt_titles not attested in the text (…ཞེས་བྱ་བ། is Na_3C9R's wording; …སྲོག་གི་སྤུ་གྲིའི… and གུར་མགོན་ལྷ་བཅུ་བདུན… match neither).

Sh_3CCs_.basis: Part 1 (Book 41, chapters 1–5) of a two-part work; Sh_3CCt_ (Book 42, chapter 6 on, colophon) is already ༼སྨད་ཆ།༽. Already uploaded: title patched on the library (PATCH /v2/texts/8Rny2ucutFoSoG5TmR9q5, 2026-10-23).

Ch_3CCU.basis: One verse by ཟླ་བ་གྲགས་པ (^1-1 ཟླ་བ་གྲགས་པས་སྨྲས་པ།) from the 50-siddhas anthology; the four extracts share its title. Name as in the compiler's note (footnote) listing ཀླུ་སྒྲུབ། ཤཱནྟ་དེ་བ། ཕྱོགས་ཀྱི་གླང་པོ། ཟླ་བ་གྲགས་པ.

Na_3C9x_.basis: One verse by Nāgārjuna (^1-1 ནཱ་གཱརྫུ་ནས་གསུངས་པ།) from the 50-siddhas anthology. ཀླུ་སྒྲུབ as in the compiler's note (footnote) listing ཀླུ་སྒྲུབ། ཤཱནྟ་དེ་བ། ཕྱོགས་ཀྱི་གླང་པོ། ཟླ་བ་གྲགས་པ and Na_3C9y_.

Sh_3CCh_.basis: One verse by ཤཱནྟ་དེ་བ (^1-1 ཤཱནྟ་དེ་བས་གསུངས་པ།) from the 50-siddhas anthology. Name as in the compiler's note (footnote) listing ཀླུ་སྒྲུབ། ཤཱནྟ་དེ་བ། ཕྱོགས་ཀྱི་གླང་པོ། ཟླ་བ་གྲགས་པ.

Di_3CEi_.basis: One verse by ཕྱོགས་ཀྱི་གླང་པོ (^1-1 ཕྱོགས་ཀྱི་གླང་པོས་སྨྲས་པ།) from the 50-siddhas anthology. ཞེས་བྱ་བ added from its own colophon (^a-1), matching the other three; the Dignāga volume (Book 75) heading lacks it. Already uploaded: title patched on the library.

Na_3C9y_.basis: One verse by ཀླུ་སྒྲུབ (^1-1 སློབ་དཔོན་ཀླུ་སྒྲུབ་ཀྱི་ཞལ་ནས།) from the 40-siddhas anthology; the three extracts share its title. Name as in the compiler's note (footnote) listing ཀླུ་སྒྲུབ། ཕྱོགས་ཀྱི་གླང་པོ། བྷུ་སུ་ཀུ.

Di_3CEj_.basis: One verse by ཕྱོགས་ཀྱི་གླང་པོ (^1-1 སློབ་དཔོན་ཕྱོགས་ཀྱི་གླང་པོའི་ཞལ་ནས།) from the 40-siddhas anthology. Name as in the compiler's note (footnote) listing ཀླུ་སྒྲུབ། ཕྱོགས་ཀྱི་གླང་པོ། བྷུ་སུ་ཀུ. Already uploaded: title patched on the library.

Sh_3CCi_.basis: One verse by བྷུ་སུ་ཀུ (^1-1 བྷུ་སུ་ཀུའི་ཞལ་ནས།) from the 40-siddhas anthology. Name as in the compiler's note (footnote) listing ཀླུ་སྒྲུབ། ཕྱོགས་ཀྱི་གླང་པོ། བྷུ་སུ་ཀུ.

Na_3CBW.basis: Own colophon title (^a-1 དཀོན་མཆོག་གསུམ་དང་མཛད་པ་བཅུ་གཉིས་ཀྱི་བཀྲ་ཤིས་ཀྱི་ཚིགས་སུ་བཅད་པ་སློབ་དཔོན་འཕགས་པ་ཀླུ་སྒྲུབ་ཀྱིས་མཛད་པ). Different work from Na_3CBX (20% similar; buddha and bodhisattva names), which keeps the plain title its own colophon gives. Same author and translators, so an author tag would not separate them. Already uploaded: title patched on the library.

Va_3CEP.basis: Author from its own colophon (^a-1 …སློབ་དཔོན་དབྱིག་གཉེན་གྱིས་མཛད་པ). Different work from Ch_3CCX (Candrakīrti, ~5× longer, different BDRC id); both carry an author tag.

Ch_3CCX.basis: Author from its own colophon (^a-1 …སློབ་དཔོན་ཟླ་བ་གྲགས་པས་མཛད་པ). Different work from Va_3CEP (Vasubandhu); both carry an author tag. Already uploaded: title patched on the library.

Na_3C9c_.basis: Author from its own colophon (^a-1 …སློབ་དཔོན་ཀླུ་སྒྲུབ་ཀྱི་ཞལ་སྔ་ནས་མཛད་པ). Different work from At_3CHL (Dīpaṃkarabhadra; ~14% shared, different homage, paṇḍita and BDRC id); both carry an author tag.

At_3CHL.basis: Author from its own colophon (^a-1 སློབ་དཔོན་མར་མེ་མཛད་བཟང་པོའི་ཞལ་སྔ་ནས་མཛད་པ). Different work from Na_3C9c_ (Nāgārjuna); both carry an author tag. Already uploaded: title patched on the library.

Na_3C9V.basis: Same work, different version: no distinguishing title is attested, so versions are numbered in volume order. Version 1: Sanskrit title …aṣṭapadastotra; 10 verses; colophon names Nāgārjuna only, no translator. Already uploaded: title patched on the library.

Na_3C9W.basis: Same work, different version: no distinguishing title is attested, so versions are numbered in volume order. Version 2: Sanskrit title …aṣṭamantrastotra; verses reordered and reworded; lacks Na_3C9V's verses 4, 8 and 10; adds the ཀྵཾ verse and a closing benefit verse; no translator named.

Na_3C9X.basis: Same work, different version: no distinguishing title is attested, so versions are numbered in volume order. Version 3: Sanskrit title …aṣṭamantrastotra; Na_3C9V's verses in the same order with spelling variants, verse 6 replaced and verse 8 missing; translated by Vairocanavajra and Ldi ri chos grags (^a-1).

Na_3CAN.basis: Same work, different version: no distinguishing title is attested, so versions are numbered in volume order. Version 1: the shorter wording of the same rite sequence as Na_3CAO; homage རྡོ་རྗེ་སྒྲོལ་མ་ལ; no author or translator named.

Na_3CAO.basis: Same work, different version: no distinguishing title is attested, so versions are numbered in volume order. Version 2: the fuller wording of the same rite sequence as Na_3CAN; homage འཕགས་མ་སྒྲོལ་མ་ལ; no author or translator named. Already uploaded: title patched on the library.

Na_3CAP.basis: Author tag from its own colophon (^a-1 …སློབ་དཔོན་འཕགས་པ་ཀླུ་སྒྲུབ་ཞབས་ཀྱིས་མཛད་པ); a different, much shorter sādhana than Na_3CAN / Na_3CAO (5% and 13% shared), whose texts name no author. BDRC WA0RT4261 (the other two have none).
